content: L’iman di Mmis n Arebbi
Marra wenni yumnen belli Yasuɛ d Lmasiḥ, aqa netta ittwaxřeq-dd zi AREBBI, uca marra wenni ittexsen wenni t-i-dd yejjin, ad ixs ɛawed wenni zzayes dd-ittwaxeřqen.
Zi man aya nessen belli nᵉttexs tarwa n AREBBI, xmi nᵉttexs AREBBI u nᵉttegg tiweṣṣa nnes.
Minzi ta d tayri n AREBBI, ad neḥḍa tiweṣṣa nnes, uca tiweṣṣa nnes war wɛarent ca.
Maɣar mkuř ijjen i dd-ittwaxeřqen zi AREBBI ad iɣelleb x ddunect. D wa d aɣřab i ittɣellaben x ddunect, aqa-t d l’iman nneɣ.
Man wen i ɣa iɣellben x ddunect, mɣir wenni yumnen belli Yasuɛ d Mmis n AREBBI!
D Wa i dd-ikkin zeg waman d Idammen, Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ. War dd-yekki zeg waman waha, maca zeg waman d Idammen.
Arruḥ d wenni icehhden, minzi Arruḥ d tidett.
Aqa din třata n yinni icehhden: Arruḥ d waman d Idammen, uca nitni s třata deg ijjen.
Mařa neqbeř cchadet n iwdan, mecḥař d tameqqrant cchadet n AREBBI. Ta d cchadet n AREBBI tenni iched x Mmis.
Wenni yumnen di Mmis n AREBBI, ɣares cchadet-a deg ixef nnes. Wenni war yuminen ca di AREBBI, aqa igga i-t d bu-ixarriqen, minzi netta war yumin ca di cchadet tenni iwca AREBBI x Mmis.
Uca ta d cchadet: AREBBI iwca aneɣ Tudart ittduman uca Tudart nni aqa-tt di Mmis.
Wenni ɣar iǧa Mmis, ɣares Tudart. Wenni war ɣar iǧi Mmis n AREBBI, war ɣares bu Tudart.
Awař d useǧem ɣar uneggaru
Uriɣ awem-dd man aya, ḥima ad tessnem belli ɣarwem Tudart ittduman, kenniw inni ittamnen deg Yisem n Mmis n AREBBI.
D ta d ttiqqet tenni ɣarneɣ dayes, mařa nettar zzayes ca n řḥajjet ɛlaḥsab min ixs Netta, Netta ad ɣarneɣ iseř.
Mařa nettwasseqneɛ nican aqa ad aneɣ iseř min ma d as nettar, xenni nettiqq belli aqa yusa-dd aneɣ min d as nettar.

Mařa ḥed iẓra umas ixeṭṭa, ijj n uxeṭṭu war ihdijen ca řmewt, ejj i-t ad iẓẓaǧ di ṭṭweɛ nnes, uca ad as temmewc Tudart, i wenni war ixeṭṭin ca ař řmewt. Aqa din axeṭṭu ař řmewt, war qqareɣ ca aqa ittxeṣṣa ad iẓẓaǧ i man aya.
Marra řmuɛṣiyyet, aqa-tt d ddenb uca aqa din ddenb i war iǧin ca ař řmewt.
Nessen belli kuř ijjen wenni dd-ittwaxeřqen zi AREBBI, war ixeṭṭi ca, minzi wenni dd-ittwaxeřqen zi AREBBI ad iḥḍa ixef nnes u amɛeffan war t ittḥidi.
Nessen, aqa aneɣ zi AREBBI uca ddunect marra aqa-tt deg ifassen n umɛeffan.
Nessen belli Mmis n AREBBI aqa yusa-dd uca iwca aneɣ-dd řefhamet ḥima ad nessen Wenni iǧan d tidett u ḥima ad niři deg Wenni d tidett, di Mmis Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ. D wa d AREBBI s tidett d Tudart ittduman.
A iḥenjiren inu, ḥḍam ixef nwem zeg weɛbed n l’aṣnam!
